check_evidence_policy.readiness_rule: A check is reusable for exact-head readiness only when its item records a concrete subject SHA/tree or artifact digest, executable/tool version, execution timestamp, and applicable environment fingerprint. 'not_recorded' makes the item audit context only, never reusable PASS evidence.
check_evidence_policy.legacy_observations: Most Phase 0 audit checks were recorded before this provenance rule and are retained honestly with missing fields rather than backfilled by inference.
check_evidence_policy.final_exact_head_evidence: Live GitHub PR metadata and comments are mutable pointers and are not readiness evidence. The exact final head requires a content-addressed append-only attestation or immutable check artifact; its absence is blocker B-006.

timestamps.strategy: Explicit UTC instants are written only when an external action is observed; validators preserve values and never inject the wall clock. Canonical JSON uses sorted keys and UTC Z notation.

self_reference_policy: The state file cannot embed the SHA of the commit that contains itself. GitHub PR metadata and the verification comment may point to the live head but are mutable and do not satisfy immutable readiness evidence. A content-addressed append-only attestation or immutable check artifact must bind the exact final commit; B-006 records that it is unavailable.
